title: Label leakage through file headers: geometry and batch confounds in public mammography datasets, and a pre-training acceptance gate
abstract: arXiv:2611.32899v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A dataset whose diagnostic label can be recovered from non-diagnostic information yields high, reproducible and uninformative model performance. We applied pre-training controls that see only image geometry, global texture, a sub-collection identifier or one covariate to six public mammography datasets, against a stop threshold of AUC 0.60. In KAU-BCMD, geometry alone predicted the BI-RADS class at AUC 1.0000 in a local copy and at a mean of 0.979 in a public Kaggle archive; after resizing, texture alone gave 0.847. In CMMD, the sub-collection prefix predicted malignancy at 0.7753; the restricted sub-collection passed geometry (0.5000) and texture (0.5810) but failed an identifier-order control added post hoc (test AUC 0.9926). CBIS-DDSM exceeded the stop on geometry (pooled mean 0.654 over 20 splits), a verdict statistic chosen post hoc; its official mass and calcification splits did not. translated_title: 通过文件头的标签泄露：公开乳腺X线摄影数据集中的几何与批次混淆因素，以及一种预训练准入门槛
translated_abstract: 能够从非诊断信息中恢复出诊断标签的数据集，会产生高、可复现但无信息量的模型性能。我们对六个公开乳腺X线摄影数据集应用了仅依赖图像几何、全局纹理、子集标识符或单一协变量的预训练控制检查，并以AUC 0.60作为停止阈值。在KAU-BCMD中，仅凭几何信息即以AUC 1.0000预测出本地副本中的BI-RADS分级，在公开Kaggle存档中平均为0.979；调整图像尺寸后，仅凭纹理得到0.847。在CMMD中，子集前缀以0.7753的AUC预测恶性；受限子集通过了几何（0.5000）和纹理（0.5810）检查，却在事后添加的标识符顺序控制检查中失败（测试AUC 0.9926）。CBIS-DDSM在几何检查上超过停止阈值（20次划分的合并均值0.654），该判定统计量为事后选定；其官方的肿块与钙化划分则未超过。M-SYNTH、INbreast和部分VinDr-Mammo（摘要原文被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一套仅利用图像几何、纹理或标识符等非诊断信息的预训练准入控制检查，以AUC 0.60为停止阈值审计六个公开乳腺X线摄影数据集，发现多个数据集存在严重标签泄露（如KAU-BCMD仅凭几何信息即能以AUC 1.0预测BI-RADS分级），并据此构建了模型预训练前的数据集验收门槛。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a pre-training acceptance gate that audits six public mammography datasets using leakage controls based only on image geometry, texture, or identifiers against an AUC 0.60 stop threshold, revealing severe label leakage (e.g., geometry alone predicts BI-RADS at AUC 1.0 in KAU-BCMD).
